tool_schemas.name: get_stories
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of stories for the requested `story_type` (`top`, `new`, `ask_hn`, `show_hn`) without comments, limited to `num_stories` (results are returned as a single page up to the requested limit). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `story_type` is not one of the supported values or if `num_stories` is not a positive integer, and RATE_LIMITED if your request quota is exceeded. Raises UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE if the upstream Hacker News source cannot be reached or fails to respond.

story_type.description: Type of stories to get, one of: `top`, `new`, `ask_hn`, `show_hn`

tool_schemas.name: get_user_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the user profile for `user_name` plus up to `num_stories` of their most recent submitted stories (results are returned as a single page up to the requested limit). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `user_name` is empty/invalid or `num_stories` is not a positive integer, NOT_FOUND if no such user exists, and RATE_LIMITED if your request quota is exceeded. Raises UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE if the upstream Hacker News source cannot be reached or fails to respond.

num_stories.description: Number of stories to get, defaults to 10

tool_schemas.name: search_stories
tool_schemas.description: Searches for stories matching `query` and returns up to `num_results` results, ordered by relevance when `search_by_date` is false and by recency when `search_by_date` is true (results are returned as a single page up to the requested limit). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is empty or `num_results` is not a positive integer, and RATE_LIMITED if your request quota is exceeded. Raises UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE if the upstream search backend cannot be reached or fails to respond.

search_by_date.description: Search by date, defaults to False. If this is False, then we search by relevance, then points, then number of comments.

num_results.description: Number of results to get, defaults to 10

tool_schemas.name: get_story_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed metadata for the specified `story_id` and the full story thread including comments (and nested replies) when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `story_id` is missing or not a positive integer, NOT_FOUND if the story does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED if your request quota is exceeded. Raises UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE if the upstream Hacker News source cannot be reached or fails to respond.

tool_schemas.name: get_item
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single Hacker News item (story or comment) by `hn_item_id`. Returns the cached entity when fresh; otherwise fetches upstream and upserts into `hn_items`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `hn_item_id` is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the item does not exist, RATE_LIMITED if your request quota is exceeded, and UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE if upstream cannot be reached.

hn_item_id.description: Upstream Hacker News item id (story or comment).

include_text_html.description: Whether to include `text_html` in the response when present. Defaults to true.

include_inactive.description: If true, allow returning items with status in `deleted` or `dead`. Defaults to false.

tool_schemas.name: list_story_feed_snapshots
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached feed snapshot rows from `hn_story_feeds` for a given `feed_type`, ordered by `snapshot_at` descending. Useful for observability and cache inspection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs and RATE_LIMITED if your request quota is exceeded.

feed_type.description: Feed type to list snapshots for.

status.description: Filter by snapshot status. Defaults to `current` when omitted.

snapshot_before.description: Only return snapshots with `snapshot_at` < this RFC3339 timestamp.

limit.description: Max number of snapshots to return (server clamps to [1,100]). Defaults to 10.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination; omit for the first page.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a stored search execution record from `search_queries` by id, including its current lifecycle `status` and timing fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `search_query_id` is invalid, NOT_FOUND if no such search query exists, and RATE_LIMITED if your request quota is exceeded.

search_query_id.description: Primary key id of the stored search query record.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_queries
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored search execution records from `search_queries`, optionally filtered by `status` and/or `normalized_query_hash`, ordered by `created_at` descending. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters and RATE_LIMITED if your request quota is exceeded.

normalized_query_hash.description: Filter by the normalized query hash used for cache de-duplication.

created_after.description: Only return rows with `created_at` >= this RFC3339 timestamp.

created_before.description: Only return rows with `created_at` < this RFC3339 timestamp.

limit.description: Max number of rows to return (server clamps to [1,100]). Defaults to 10.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination; omit for the first page.

tool_schemas.name: expire_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Forces a completed search query into the `expired` state (lifecycle transition `completed -> expired`) so the next `search_stories` call will re-execute upstream. Refuses to expire queries not in `completed`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the query does not exist, CONFLICT if the transition is not allowed from the current state, and RATE_LIMITED if your request quota is exceeded.

search_query_id.description: Primary key id of the search query record to expire.

tool_schemas.name: get_auth_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and current entitlements, including granted scopes and current rate-limit/quota consumption for this service. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED if no valid credentials are presented.

api_key.description: API key credential for this service. If omitted, the server will attempt to use a configured default credential when available.
